title: DAG-Hesse: Inter-Layer Hessian Analysis of Neural Networks with DAG Architectures
description: Code and experimental results for the paper 'Inter-Layer Hessian Analysis of Neural Networks with DAG Architectures'. Provides exact and stochastic inter-layer Hessian computation, Gauss-Newton decomposition, and diagnostic metrics (resonance, coupling, stable rank, GN-Gap) for neural networks with arbitrary DAG architectures.
